coordinator: root coordinator; one dispatch record per task
objective: Test new public procurement observations while permitting null, disproved and unresolved outcomes; no assumption that fraud must be found.

sampling.method: Purposive bounded cohort, not a representative national sample
sampling.ordering: Within fixed issue-date window, choose most recent official RFQs first; tie-break by solicitation identifier ascending
sampling.pilot_inclusion: The acquired SPE4A626U3619 RFQ counts toward 30 only if the fixed selection rule includes it; otherwise it remains calibration
sampling.coverage_claim: Only the recorded cohort, documents and queries

tasks.question: Can a declared recent machine-bolt cohort be assembled from official public RFQs?
outputs: cohort.json with every selected, excluded, duplicate, failed and empty-history record
hashed official RFQs and source/access log
stopping_conditions: 30 unique qualifying RFQs processed, or 120 candidate URLs / 12 listing reads exhausted
Document requires unavailable authentication, restricted technical access or an access-control workaround
Official listing does not support a reproducible population: publish that limitation without substituting an undisclosed convenience sample

tasks.question: Which history keys can be resolved to original priced award/order lines and modifications?
outputs: dated contract/order/CLIN relationship table
original document hashes and page locators
missing-record log distinguishing unavailable from not searched

limits.selection_order: Most recent historical award date first, then contract identifier ascending; deduplicate before selection

stopping_conditions: 30 contract keys resolved or explicitly unresolved, or request/read budget exhausted
A purported order is only a solicitation, mirror or aggregate award record: retain its actual type
No accessible original priced line: leave price verification false

tasks.question: Are items, revisions, conditions and purchased units equivalent?
outputs: item-equivalence matrix with NSN, part, revision, condition, UI, QUP and conversion evidence
blocked comparisons with exact missing fields
stopping_conditions: Every retained line classified equivalent, different or unknown
No evidenced unit conversion: no normalized price
Restricted or unavailable technical revision: unresolved, not assumed identical

tasks.question: Do original pages support each retained row and amount classification?
outputs: independent extraction receipt and source hash checks
duplicate/modification reconciliation
corrections bound to exact source pages
stopping_conditions: Every retained row verified or excluded
Mismatched source hash or unreconciled changed document: block affected record
No double counting of an IDV and child order, or original and modified line

tasks.question: Do fully supported comparable prices retain an unexplained difference?
outputs: pair-level comparison table with all blocked pairs
reviewed adjustment evidence for quantity, date, freight, delivery, warranty, qualification and nonrecurring costs
up to ten non-accusatory questions for further records work
stopping_conditions: All retained pairs classified eligible or blocked
Missing term or unauthenticated adjustment flag: comparison remains blocked
Price gap alone: no fraud label, loss figure or reward estimate

tasks.question: Does a transaction-specific identity discrepancy survive legal-name, alias and role checks?
inputs: DR-02 exact recipient/CAGE/UEI and contract identifiers
outputs: dated identifier/name/profile-level matrix
source-reported versus independently checked parent/role assertions
contradiction or benign-explanation record

limits.selection_order: Recipients of the first ten retained contract keys in DR-02 selection order; deduplicate

stopping_conditions: Ten recipients checked or finite budget exhausted
Punctuation, a similar name, absent search result or distinct UEI alone: do not escalate
No public ownership history: mark unknown; do not substitute residential/contact data

tasks.question: What does each retained question add to already public enforcement, audits or litigation?
outputs: dated DOJ/OIG/GAO/agency/court query log
exact known-case matches and differences
analytical novelty statement and unresolved government-knowledge field
stopping_conditions: Every retained question classified already public, materially distinct, or unresolved
Known allegation matches: retain calibration status rather than rename a discovery
Negative public search: say not located within recorded search, never government unaware

tasks.question: What evidence would falsify each remaining question, and does that evidence exist?
outputs: separate challenge receipt
at least two plausible alternatives per retained question
accept, narrow, reject or unresolved decision with missing discriminating evidence
stopping_conditions: Every retained question challenged within budget
Ordinary explanation resolves pattern: reject or narrow
No transaction-specific false representation, delivery or billing basis: retain as price/data-quality question

tasks.question: What reviewable next records step, if any, is justified?
outputs: cohort completion report including null outcomes
reviewed neutral public graph additions
separate decision on any concrete records or referral proposal
stopping_conditions: Declared cohort and all finite subwork accounted for
No supported question survives: close with null result
Any case-specific external action requires its own concrete reviewed content and applicable authorization

tasks.question: Can the specific unresolved speech, scope and procurement-rule questions be resolved?
outputs: official audio verification or explicit unresolved status
dated current authority/deviation version note
bill-number/action crosswalk where established
stopping_conditions: Listed unresolved items checked or budget exhausted
Official audio unavailable: preserve non-government transcript attribution
Full applicable deviation unavailable: no procurement-compliance flag
No enactment evidence: preserve proposal status

external_provider_handoffs.connection: blocked; automatic approval review rejected administrator permissions and separate unapproved inference gateway scope
external_provider_handoffs.depends_on: An explicitly approved appropriate route and verified active connection, or actual manual handoff
external_provider_handoffs.budget_source: Immutable task packet; at most 12 public searches and 20 document/API reads
external_provider_handoffs.stop: No verified route/receipt means no dispatch; do not retry authorization through another route under this queue

external_provider_handoffs.depends_on: Verified active connection and actual dispatch receipt, or actual manual handoff
external_provider_handoffs.budget_source: Immutable task packet; at most 12 public searches and 20 document/API reads
external_provider_handoffs.stop: Pending authorization is not permission or successful execution

cross_provider_rule: Provider packets do not automatically execute DR tasks. They return separate bounded results for independent review; avoid duplicate uncontrolled work.

exclude_automatic_publication: personal contact/residential data unrelated to a public official role
public_bank_contract.relationships: Distinguish observed, source-reported, independently verified, proposed, unresolved and rejected; no similarity edge proves fraud.

global_stopping_conditions: Complete finite task budget even if no case is found
Access denied or unavailable credentials: log and stop that source; no credential guessing or circumvention
Unresolved unit, revision, amount scope or duplicate relation: block affected inference
No fraud probability or earned reward from a model score
